main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (rows ~1-30) on a brown trunk with root flare (rows 30-46)
top_band: Canopy: lighter green highlight clumps at top rows 1-8, shading to darker greens below; trunk has no separate top surface. Organic form, so there is no flat top band to read.
evidence: Organic canopy lit from above: the highlights on the top of the dome and the dark underside at rows 26-30 give a volumetric top-lit mass. The trunk is a vertical column with a right-hand shadow side and a flared root base, which is normal for a tree in this view. No isometric side face is drawn. The canopy reads as a rounded volume rather than a flat elevation.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 greens in clumped dithering, with a dark green outline and a dark green underside, matching the leaf-clump approach of the reference. The trunk has 3-4 browns, a light left side and a dark right side, with a root flare. The outline is a tinted dark green or brown rather than black. The canopy clump detail is softer and blockier than the reference's distinct leaf clusters, and the trunk is fairly smooth with little bark grain, so density is slightly under the reference. It would sit acceptably next to the references, though.
